facts.text: "Brad, Janet, you'll stay the night. Dinner is ready, and so is the laboratory."
facts.why: Frank never says this. It is in quote marks and signed Dr Frank-N-Furter, so it reads as a film line. His real lines are on the quote page.
facts.fix: It's not easy having a good time! Even smiling makes my face ache!
